headline: Bosch lists a DMS verification role covering model/schematic equivalence and model accuracy checks
fact: On October 5, Bosch Service Solutions listed a Valencia DMS Verification Engineer role for mixed-signal SoCs. The position defines the split between DMS and digital verification and model/schematic equivalence, validates behavioral-model accuracy and performance against circuit simulations and measurements, and debugs RTL, gate and schematic behavior. It also assigns verification planning, regressions, functional/code coverage and UVM infrastructure improvements. The posting is a hiring mandate and does not establish measured verification outcomes.
